sentiment_evidence: ईमेल आ गया! अब सही चल रहा है।

issues.title: Autoresponder email not sent to form leads
issues.problem_statement: Leads were coming in through the customer's form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

issues.title: Sender domain verification for email deliverability
issues.problem_statement: Support advised that autoresponder emails can sometimes land in spam, so verifying the sender domain is a good idea.

items.description: Customer turned on the autoresponder option in the form settings and saved it, following support's guidance, after support saw that it was switched off.
evidence: यहाँ ऑटोरिस्पॉन्डर वाला विकल्प बंद है। इसे चालू करके सेव कर दीजिए।

items.description: Customer submitted a test form using another email address, following support's guidance, and confirmed that the autoresponder email arrived and everything is now working.
evidence: अब अपने दूसरे ईमेल से एक टेस्ट फ़ॉर्म भरिए।
भर दिया... हाँ, ईमेल आ गया! अब सही चल रहा है।

items.description: Support explained that the email can sometimes go to spam, so verifying the sender domain is advisable, and that this can be done in the email domain section of the settings.
evidence: ईमेल कभी-कभी स्पैम में जा सकता है, इसलिए सेंडर डोमेन वेरिफ़ाई कर लेना अच्छा रहेगा।
आप सेटिंग्स में ईमेल डोमेन वाले हिस्से में कर सकते हैं।

items.description: Customer will verify the sender domain in the email domain section of the settings.
evidence: ठीक है, मैं कल सुबह वह कर लूँगा।

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
